acceptanceCriteria: a load harness with ~15 concurrent writers on a store of >=40,000 receipts records per-verb gate hold time and LOCK_TIMEOUT rate before and after, numbers retained

no lease write (claim, renew, heartbeat, release, reap, widen, pool family) runs a complete-history audit while holding the preparation gate; refusals are decided before entering the gate; a test pins it and a mutation that moves the audit back inside the gate fails it
heartbeat/renew wait is bounded by fast-route cost (<1 s p99 in the harness) regardless of journal size, and LOCK_TIMEOUT at ~15 writers is near zero in the retained run
proposals 2, 3 and 5 are either delivered or filed as their own tickets; any change to accepted receipt or audit semantics is recorded as an owner decision
body: From GitHub beamfall/corvint#967 (2026-10-16). On a real queue (~42,000 receipts, ~600 MB state, ~15 concurrent writers) writers wait up to 3.5 min and fail LOCK_TIMEOUT at ~150/h; every timeout names the preparation gate (taskman.prepare.lock), never the writer lock. Over 12 h the gate made no progress for >=45 s while writers queued on 120 occasions (172 min, 24% of wall time). Fast-route heartbeat/renew hold 0.47-0.70 s; complete-route verbs (pool acquire/prepare/observe/release/cleanup/recover, reap, widen, submit, complete) run the complete audit from receipt 1 inside the gate, refusals included, landing a median 42-52 s after the previous commit; 73% of writes are heartbeat/renew queued behind them. Code refs at 05be582: internal/tasks/store/lease_write.go:323 (gate held across writer route and prepareLease; audit 153-176; handoff scan 263-266); writer_route.go:159-168; journal/audit.go:296; store/lease.go:66-98,218-225 (inline reap via complete route); pool_commands.go:274; store/writer_checkpoint.go:374,387-427 (>=512 receipts: caller-side complete audit abandoned on SNAPSHOT_MOVED); journal/writer_checkpoint.go:40,522 (4,096-receipt cliff), 48-50; cli/lease.go:69-73 (reap has no --lock-wait). Also observed locally by the orchestrator on 2026-10-16: repeated LOCK_TIMEOUT on taskman.prepare.lock during claim/submit/ticket create with ~5 concurrent closeouts. Proposed (issue order): 1 no complete-history work while holding the gate (serve pool/reap/widen from the writer checkpoint or prepare optimistically outside the gate; decide refusals from the checkpoint first); 2 incremental single-owner checkpoint refresh tolerating appends, remove the WriterFullBound cliff; 3 bound per-write payload/history (receipts carry deltas or refs, no unchanged post-images); 4 isolate liveness writes from complete-route transactions; 5 operability (--lock-wait on reap, report the gate holder in status/doctor, opt-in --timing). Related: V1-0916 (writer refresh audit in caller), V1-1468 (--lock-wait gaps), V1-1150 (reap/sweep --lock-wait), V1-0803 (SNAPSHOT_MOVED questions), closed GitHub #494, #545.
title: corvint-tasks: lease writes serialize behind a preparation gate held during complete-history audits, so ~15 writers hit LOCK_TIMEOUT ~150/h (GitHub #967)
